title: Decoding the Mind of Large Language Models: A Quantitative Evaluation of Ideology and Biases
findings: On religious topics like the existence of God and the afterlife, ChatGPT tended to be neutral, whereas Gemini consistently negated these questions, suggesting a potential bias. In a comparison of happiness, ChatGPT leaned towards the idea that people who practice religion are happier, while Gemini remained completely neutral.
